top.line: Mark the page, photograph it, let an agent process it
top.para: Dinis loves books but never captured what he learned, because nobody processed the marks, so marking stopped. Reviewing his book on paper, he found the fix: photograph pen-marked pages and an agent reads, flags, redraws and writes them up. Thirteen pages gave 83 notes, and the book's new name.

in-short.line: Books, three moments, and the one that failed
in-short.para: A book is the best medium and its inefficiencies are features. Reading means read, mark, process; the third never happened, so marking stopped. An agent now does it from a photograph, the title changed in the margins, and authors can get feedback this way.

medium.line: Unconnected, unlinked, no undo: the book's features
medium.para: Dinis buys many books because a book suits him better than a screen: focus, no links, no undo. He learns in graphs and connections, and books are where many start.

three.line: Without processing, marking was not worth its cost
three.para: Reading, marking and processing are three moments. Processing took hours and never happened, so highlighting stopped, and sometimes reading did too, losing the ideas formed at the best moment. The notes on August's printed graphs books never reached the site.

today.line: A pen, a phone, and an agent that asks
today.para: Dinis marks the page, photographs it, and the journalist agent captures each note word for word, redraws the page, sketches the change and asks when unsure. Thirteen pages gave 83 notes and 7 uncertain readings, five confirmed that day.

margins.line: From ZX developer to ZX founder, in pen
margins.para: Page 4 asks whether ZX founder is a better name; page 8 says 'ZX FOUNDER? :)'; page 10 says it should be about the reader. The same day the title became Generation ZX Founders (GenAI Edition), with other notes becoming decisions too.

every-book.line: The workflow for every book, paper and magazine
every-book.para: Read with a pen, photograph later, and a Claude session captures, writes up and connects the notes so they can be found again: focus while reading, hyperlinks afterwards.

author.line: Authors get the reader's thinking, unpackaged
author.para: Reviewers can mark pages or record a memo and skip the third step; the agent packages it, so feedback no longer dies in the margin. The book's site wrote up the reviewers' side.

crude.line: Already valuable, before any tool exists
crude.para: A phone camera, a chat and a site that keeps the record are enough today. New model capabilities open doors like this, found only by using them.

limits.line: Three batches, imperfect reading, one reader
limits.para: The counts cover 13 of 168 pages. Seven readings were uncertain and flagged. The workflow is a day old and untested on other handwriting; it is not a tool.

sources.line: A memo and the book site's review records
sources.para: Dinis's memo of 19 October 2026, the book site's RC2 on paper records and drawings, its paper-that-talks-both-ways article and decisions 016, 017 and 019.
